visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a person's hand grasping a metallic door handle on a white-framed glass door. Upon turning the handle, an orange and white cat enters the room immediately, followed by a calico cat. The setting is a bright indoor space with light-colored wooden floors. (2) The orange cat stands in the center of the wooden floor, looking up and meowing persistently with its mouth wide open. A white cat with black spots runs past in the background. (3) The orange cat is then seen jumping onto a two-tiered wooden coffee table. It stands prominently on the top tier, meowing directly at the camera with an intense expression. (4) A quick montage follows, showing the orange cat in various positions—at the door, on the table, and on a green rug—all while meowing loudly and looking toward the person filming. (5) A person's legs dressed in black trousers and hands become visible as they walk across the wooden floor carrying a white bowl. The orange cat follows closely at their heels. (6) The person places a white ceramic bowl containing beige, textured food onto the wooden table. The orange cat begins eating immediately and vigorously. (7) A close-up shot shows the orange cat and other cats (calico and tortoiseshell) eating from similar white bowls. The food appears to be a smooth mousse topped with a light yellow powder. (8) The camera pans across a stack of cat food cans with light-colored labels next to a blue pouch and a small white sign. (9) A person's hands are shown using a white spatula to scoop a thick, brownish mousse-like cat food out of a silver can. The texture is dense and finely grained. (10) The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring white text and a logo in the center.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp mechanical sound of a door handle clicking followed by a door opening creak. High-pitched, urgent, and repetitive cat meows dominate the soundscape, exhibiting high vocal arousal and varying pitch contours. (2) Each meow occurs in sync with a quick visual cut. The sound of light, rapid footsteps on a wooden floor is briefly audible between meows. (3) A cheerful, mid-tempo BGM featuring an acoustic guitar strumming pattern and light electronic percussion fades in around the 17-second mark. The meowing continues over the music. (4) A low-frequency thud is heard as a bowl is placed on a table. The intensity of the meowing shifts to the rhythmic sound of wet licking and subtle crunching as the cat begins to eat. (5) A clear, female voice with a friendly, professional, and bright tone begins narrating the product benefits at the 40-second mark. The speech is well-articulated and synchronized with the text on screen. (6) The metallic sound of a can lid being popped open and the scraping sound of a spatula against metal are clearly heard during the demonstration. (7) The video ends with a short musical jingle that resolves to a bright, clean note as the logo appears.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> Evidence -> CTA: The video starts with a humorous montage of cats 'demanding' food, followed by the evidence of them enjoying the specific product, and concludes with a call to action regarding a promotion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a commercial designed to promote 'Lady Flavor's' new cat food line. It uses the relatable and humorous situation of cats being impatient for mealtime to grab attention, demonstrates the product's appealing texture and health benefits (collagen), and ends with a limited-time promotional offer for a free utensil to drive sales.
